name: What is a 1031 Exchange and how does it work for investment properties?

mainEntity.name: What is a 1031 Exchange and how does it work for investment properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 1031 Exchange, also known as a like-kind exchange, allows an investor to defer capital gains taxes when selling an investment property if the proceeds are reinvested into a similar type of property within specific timeframes. This strategy is frequently used by investors to grow their portfolios without immediate tax burdens. Strict IRS rules apply, including identifying a replacement property within 45 days and closing within 180 days. A real estate professional can help identify eligible properties and work with qualified intermediaries to ensure compliance, especially when dealing with various property types in the South Florida market.
acceptedAnswer.description: A 1031 Exchange defers capital gains tax when reinvesting investment property proceeds into a like-kind property within IRS-specified timeframes.
